# 构建、打包与诊断结果

[API 任务入口](../../index.md) · [公开模块](../index.md)

`buildProject` 读取项目配置、依赖和游戏根，编译并验证最终模组。检查 `success` 后再使用产物；失败时诊断包含位置与代码，并保留上一次成功输出。`check: true` 用于只验证，`writeEditor` 同步编辑器声明。`packProject` 先构建再生成可搬移 ZIP，成功时返回 `archive`。

`BuildResult.files` 是产物清单与校验摘要，`OutputFile` 则是内存中的字节数据。只编译一段源码、不需要资源和世界验证时使用[编译器入口](../compiler/compile.md)。

## 使用示例

```ts
import { buildProject, packProject } from "krieg-lang/project";

const checked = buildProject("./my-mod", { check: true });
if (!checked.success) console.error(checked.diagnostics);
else {
  const packed = packProject("./my-mod");
  if (packed.archive) console.log(packed.archive);
}
```

## buildProject() { #buildproject }

> **buildProject**(`project?`: `string`, `options?`: [`ProjectBuildOptions`](#projectbuildoptions) & `object`): [`BuildResult`](#buildresult)

Defined in: [src/project/build.ts:63](https://github.com/maxmixalex/krieg-lang/blob/main/src/project/build.ts#L63)

Compile the source-package graph against the effective game roots and validate the resulting mod. A failed build leaves the last successful output in place.

### Parameters { #buildproject-section-parameters }

| Parameter | Type | Default value |
| ------ | ------ | ------ |
| `project?` | `string` | `"."` |
| `options?` | [`ProjectBuildOptions`](#projectbuildoptions) & `object` | `{}` |

### Returns { #buildproject-section-returns }

[`BuildResult`](#buildresult)

### Example { #buildproject-section-example }

```ts
const result = buildProject("./my-mod", { gameRoots: ["/games/hoi4", "/mods/Kaiserreich"] });
if (!result.success) console.error(result.diagnostics);
```
